_comment: Everything the smoke suites are allowed to report. One entry per fact, each with the reason it cannot be fixed by rendering harder. Anything not listed here fails the suite.

unresolvedVisuals.XuiScrollEnd: Named by a XuiControl inside dashuisk/skin.xur itself and by nothing else in the build. No skin in Blades 6770 defines a XuiVisual with this Id, so the console had nothing to draw either.
unresolvedVisuals.XuiScrollEndUp: Same: referenced only from within dashuisk/skin.xur, defined nowhere in the build.
unresolvedVisuals.txt_Starting: network/Status.xur asks for it and no skin in the build defines it. The only unresolved visual named by a real scene; recorded, never substituted.

missingImages...\\..\\Common\\Star.png: An XuiTool source-tree path that escapes the pack, inside skin.xur's btn_4high_ratings visual. That visual is referenced by nothing outside skin.xur. A file of the same basename exists in shrdres and gamercar but nothing proves the console resolved it that way, so we do not guess.
missingImages...\\..\\..\\dash\\main\\media\\ico_32x_c: Same, in skin.xur's Finding_Camera_Large visual, which no scene references.
